{
  "findings": [
    {
      "title": "Inconsistent cemiplimab dose in synopsis vs body",
      "quote": "Cemiplimab 437 mg given by intravenous (IV) infusion over 30 minutes Q3W",
      "page": 18,
      "section": "Synopsis",
      "category": "consistency",
      "severity": "critical",
      "explanation": "The synopsis states cemiplimab 437 mg, but the body (Section 6.1) states 350 mg. This is a critical dosing discrepancy that must be resolved.",
      "fix": "Align the dose in the synopsis with the body; confirm the correct dose and update accordingly."
    },
    {
      "title": "Inconsistent sample size in synopsis",
      "quote": "Approximately 126 patients are planned to be enrolled in the study.",
      "page": 19,
      "section": "Synopsis",
      "category": "consistency",
      "severity": "critical",
      "explanation": "The synopsis states 126 patients, but the Statistical Plan section states 105 patients. This inconsistency affects sample size and power calculations.",
      "fix": "Reconcile the sample size; update the synopsis and statistical plan to a single consistent number."
    },
    {
      "title": "Inconsistent response assessment timepoint",
      "quote": "Patients will be assessed for response at cycle 1 day 52 (week 7)",
      "page": 18,
      "section": "Synopsis",
      "category": "consistency",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The synopsis says day 52, but the body (Section 6.1) says day 50. This discrepancy could affect scheduling and data collection.",
      "fix": "Standardize the response assessment timepoint to either day 50 or day 52 across all documents."
    },
    {
      "title": "Inconsistent CR discontinuation timepoint",
      "quote": "Patients with confirmed complete response (CR) after a minimum of 60 weeks of treatment may elect to discontinue treatment",
      "page": 18,
      "section": "Synopsis",
      "category": "consistency",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The synopsis states 60 weeks, but the body (Section 6.1) states 48 weeks. This affects patient treatment duration and study conduct.",
      "fix": "Align the minimum treatment duration for CR discontinuation between synopsis and body."
    },
    {
      "title": "Missing trial schema and overall design description",
      "quote": "This will be a single-arm, phase 2, global study of treatment with cemiplimab + ISA101b",
      "page": 18,
      "section": "Synopsis",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The protocol lacks a trial schema figure and a detailed overall design description (M11 1.1.2, 1.2). The synopsis provides only a brief narrative, and the body does not include a schema.",
      "fix": "Add a trial schema figure and a comprehensive overall design section in the protocol body."
    },
    {
      "title": "Missing trial stopping rules",
      "quote": "until progression or any reason for early discontinuation",
      "page": 18,
      "section": "Synopsis",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "critical",
      "explanation": "The protocol does not specify trial stopping rules (M11 4.3). There is no description of criteria for early termination of the trial due to safety, efficacy, or futility.",
      "fix": "Add a section on trial stopping rules, including safety stopping boundaries and any interim futility analysis criteria."
    },
    {
      "title": "Missing contraception and lifestyle restrictions",
      "quote": "pregnancy test for women of childbearing potential",
      "page": 19,
      "section": "Synopsis",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The protocol mentions pregnancy testing but lacks detailed contraception requirements and lifestyle restrictions (M11 5.4, 5.5). This is essential for a study with an investigational vaccine and immunotherapy.",
      "fix": "Add sections on contraception requirements for both men and women, and lifestyle restrictions (e.g., alcohol, sexual activity, diet)."
    },
    {
      "title": "Missing access to trial intervention after end of trial",
      "quote": "The end of the study is defined as the date of the last contact of the last patient in the study.",
      "page": 19,
      "section": "Synopsis",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The protocol does not describe post-trial access to cemiplimab or ISA101b for patients who may benefit (M11 4.5). This is an ethical and regulatory requirement.",
      "fix": "Add a section describing whether and how patients can access the investigational intervention after the trial ends, including any extension or compassionate use programs."
    }
  ]
}
